description: This file defines the 'TabGroupHelper' class which provides methods to manage and save tab groups for modules in SuiteCRM, including handling language-specific labels and interface updates.

classes.name: TabGroupHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing module tab groups, including fetching available modules and saving tab group configurations with language support.

methods.name: getAvailableModules
methods.description: Returns a list of available modules, optionally filtered for a specific language.

methods.name: saveTabGroups
methods.description: Processes request parameters to save and update tab group labels and module assignments, handling multi-language support and UI refresh.
